entry_requirements: Every location must have exactly one primary entry room tagged 'transit'
Entry room must connect to at least 2 other rooms
Entry room cannot be a reward room
Entry room density must be 'sparse' or 'moderate'
choke_point_rules: At least one room must serve as a chokepoint (single-connection bottleneck) for locations with 6+ rooms
Chokepoints must not be the entry room
reward_room_rules: Locations with 6+ rooms should have at least one high-value room (tagged 'command', 'hidden', or 'storage')
Reward rooms should be at maximum graph distance from the entry
Reward rooms should have exactly 1 entry point
exit_requirements: At least one room must have has_alternate_exit: true for locations with 8+ rooms
Alternate exits must not be the primary entry room
